overall: The AG found the Canton Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a notice without naming license applicants and by omitting a list of documents from the December 27, 2023 minutes; the other two allegations were rejected.

allegations.summary: The December 27 notice listed only 'Annual License Renewals' without naming the license applicants or holders being considered.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an insufficiently specific notice where it failed to list the applicants or licensees.

allegations.summary: The December 27 minutes referenced documents used during the meeting but did not include a list of those documents.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the minutes are insufficient where they fail to include a list of the documents used.

allegations.summary: The Board discussed a Paul Revere Heritage Site bathroom installation bid that allegedly was not on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board has explained, and the complainant has identified no evidence to the contrary, that the discussion of the Paul Revere Heritage Site bathroom installation was unanticipated.

allegations.summary: The Board allegedly failed to announce at the December 27 meeting that the meeting was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: we credit the Board’s assertion that the announcement of recording was made at the start of the meeting but not captured in the recording that the complainant presumably viewed, and we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the December 27 meeting to include a list of documents used during the meeting, if not already done, within 30 days of the letter.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to amend the minutes of the December 27 meeting to include a list of documents used during the meeting, if it has not already done so, within 30 days of the date of this letter.
